rows.notes: Bool replaces the numeric zero/one result; byte arguments are U8.
Length is public; every byte in equal-length inputs is read, with SIMD blocks and an exact fringe.
A Bool selects a full equal-length copy; mismatched dimensions return an atomic named error.

rows.remaining: Nested architecture-specific timing scope, descendant task inheritance, and foreign-call state restoration need runtime/scheduler support. ARM FEAT_DIT cannot be represented by a universal no-op.

rows.notes: The shorter complete input is written; exact aliases work and a short destination fails before mutation.

limitations: Concrete host instruction/dataflow auditing and actual foreign object emission are distinct from cross-architecture execution or a formal timing proof.
